name: Law Firm
description: Starter pack for a law practice: court deadlines, limitation periods, trust accounting and professional compliance.

definitions.title: Daily court deadline check
definitions.note: Review today's and tomorrow's court dates, filings and limitation deadlines across all files.

definitions.title: Weekly trust account review
definitions.note: Review trust balances and upcoming trust disbursements.

definitions.title: Weekly billing and time entries
definitions.note: Enter time and issue client invoices.

definitions.title: Monthly file status review
definitions.note: Review every open file for progress and next steps.

definitions.title: Monthly limitation period scan
definitions.note: Scan all files for limitation periods expiring in the next 6 months.

definitions.title: Monthly trust reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile trust accounts and file the working papers.

definitions.title: Quarterly CPD tracking
definitions.note: Check continuing professional development hours for every lawyer.

definitions.title: Law society annual report
definitions.note: File the law society annual report and member renewals.

definitions.title: Malpractice insurance review
definitions.note: Review errors and omissions insurance coverage before renewal.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc court filing deadline
definitions.note: A specific filing or hearing deadline - set the due date when creating it.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc client intake
definitions.note: New client conflict check, retainer and file opening.
